expectations.text: Article 30(2) is the baseline clause set for ALL ICT service contracts
expectations.evidence: 'Baseline clauses, Art. 30(2)(a)-(i), apply to ALL ICT service contracts'

expectations.text: Article 30(3) adds the stricter set for critical or important functions
expectations.evidence: 'Additional clauses, Art. 30(3), apply because the contract supports a critical or important function'

expectations.text: Exit strategies with a mandatory transition period sit at 30(3)(f)
expectations.evidence: 'Exit strategies with a mandatory transition period (Art. 30(3)(f))'

expectations.text: Unrestricted audit, access and inspection rights belong to the 30(3) critical/important set
expectations.evidence: 'Unrestricted audit, access and inspection rights' listed under the Art. 30(3) additional clauses

expectations.text: Register of Information duties (maintain and submit annually) sit in Article 28(3)
expectations.evidence: Register of Information attributed only to CIR (EU) 2024/2956; Article 28(3) is never mentioned
